# Assure AI

Assure AI is the deterministic truth engine for high-stakes documents. It verifies every claim, number, and citation in AI-generated business documents against the source files, producing an audit-ready trail of provenance.

## Product

- Deterministic math verification with formal logic (Z3)
- Page-level provenance: every output points to its exact source page
- Adversarial audit that flags contradictions and unsupported claims before export
- Audit-ready export with cryptographic locks and reviewer sign-offs
- Works with the user's own model keys; documents processed on Assure servers, never used for training

## Who it is for

Investment bankers and analysts (CIMs, financial models), clinical and grant researchers (abstracts vs raw tables), legal counsel and compliance (contract review, regulatory submissions), technical architects (spec documentation), journalists and fact-checkers (source-grounded quotes).

## Positioning

Most enterprise AI tools extract, draft, or search documents. Assure is built to prove that every output is grounded in the source. The output is a document; the product is verification.
